what_to_export: Run Export data for all dates, then export the Account List and Attachments so your accountant has the chart of accounts and the receipts.
where_it_lives: ⚙ Settings > Tools > Export data > Reports + Lists > Export to Excel
left_behind_check: - Estimates and purchase orders (export from Sales or Expense transactions) - Customer statements (print to PDF per customer) - Attachments (Settings → Lists → Attachments → Batch actions → Export) - Recurring templates, chart of accounts, products and services (export each from its report)

what_to_export: Export All contacts, the chart of accounts and a Profit and Loss and Balance Sheet for every year you've been on Xero.
left_behind_check: - Contact group membership isn't a column in the contacts CSV - Anything you only keep as an attachment (check the files you need)

what_to_export: Bulk-download every invoice as PDF and export the clients CSV. Those two cover most of what you'll ever be asked for.
left_behind_check: - Estimates and proposals: PDFs one by one, or a CSV by request from Support - Payroll is a separate set of reports and tax PDFs

what_to_export: If you run two businesses in one Wave login, switch to each one and run the export separately.
where_it_lives: Settings > Data Export > Accounting / Receipts / Payroll
left_behind_check: - Other businesses in the same login (export each one) - Products and services, and the chart of accounts, per migration guides

what_to_export: Export all clients as CSV, then open Reports and export the client and job reports your new software will ask for.
where_it_lives: Clients > More Actions > Export Clients > CSV or vCard
left_behind_check: - Jobs, quotes, invoices and visit history (export from Reports) - Job photos and attachments

what_to_export: Set the jobs date range from your first day on Housecall Pro to today before you export.
where_it_lives: Customers > Actions > Export > Send to email
left_behind_check: - Anything outside the date range you set - Anything that isn't a column in the file, like job photos (open it and check)

what_to_export: Export All contacts with “All properties and associations on records” as CSV, then do the same for companies and deals.
where_it_lives: CRM > Contacts > All contacts > Export > Customize > All properties
left_behind_check: - Calls, notes, emails and other activity (export individual records, activity reports, or use the API) - Calls can be exported from CRM → Calls

what_to_export: Export deals, people and organizations, then activities and notes, and check that the IDs line up across files.
where_it_lives: Account menu > Tools and apps > Export data > CSV or Excel
left_behind_check: - Activities, notes and files (separate exports) - Files stored in Google Drive

what_to_export: Export the full customer directory and a Transactions CSV for every year you've used Square.
where_it_lives: Customers > Customer directory > Import / Export > Export customers
left_behind_check: - Card numbers never come to you directly - Some names captured from card swipes show on Transactions but not in the directory export (per Square's seller community)

what_to_export: Export customers and all payments for each year, then download the Balance summary for your accountant.
where_it_lives: Customers > Filter > Export > Columns + date range
left_behind_check: Card and bank details in the customer export.

what_to_export: Request one “Balance affecting” CSV per year back to when you opened the account.
where_it_lives: Activity > All Reports > Activities > Activity Report > Create Report

what_to_export: Export each audience and keep all four CSVs, including the unsubscribed and cleaned ones.
left_behind_check: - Opens, clicks and signup source - Purchase history - Campaign reports (download each report separately)

what_to_export: Export all contacts and download the CSV the same day.
left_behind_check: Campaign reporting, which lives in each campaign's report.

what_to_export: Filter meetings to all time and export, then screenshot each event type's settings.
left_behind_check: Your event type setup and availability rules (screenshot them)

what_to_export: Export all orders, all customers with tags, and all products, and check the three emails arrive.
where_it_lives: Orders > Export > All orders > Export orders
left_behind_check: - Your theme and pages - Authorizations in transaction history (captured payments only)

what_to_export: Pick your main blog, export, and download every image on the site before you cancel.
where_it_lives: Settings > Import & export content > Export > WordPress
left_behind_check: - Store, portfolio and index pages - Product, audio and video blocks - Extra blogs, drafts, styles, custom CSS, headers and footers

what_to_export: Export contacts and every CMS collection, then save each page's text and images into a folder.
left_behind_check: - The design, pages and code - Labels in the Google CSV format

what_to_export: Before you delete a departing employee's account, run Takeout or a Data Export for that user.
where_it_lives: takeout.google.com > Choose products > Delivery > Create export
left_behind_check: Drive files in shared drives or owned by someone else (they're in the owner's export).
